newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes up, IPB hit by results.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes up, IPB hit by results.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rose on Monday despite a heavy decline from the index's third most highly capitalised banking issue, IPB Bank, after it announced sharply lower first half profit figures.
The PX50 rose 3.3 points, 0.66 percent, to 506.7 but overall turnover on the bourse was just 604 million crowns
IPB lost seven crowns, or 2.7 percent, to 255. Earlier on Monday, IPB posted first half after-tax profits of 445 million crowns down from 830 million in the same period last year.
"Friday's rise in price was just speculation and I expect a decline, said Miroslav Nosal of Patria Finance.
IPB posted strong gains at the end of last week following an annuncement that Nomura Securities Co Ltd International would take a 36 percent stake in the bank.
The Finance Mnistry said Nomura would pay around six billion crowns although a figure would be finalised after an audit.
Elsewhere, SPT Telecom had a turbulant day closing up 74 crowns to 3,715. Komercni Banka rose 14 crowns to 1,630 and power utility CEZ moved up 11 crowns to close at 912.
